name: LinkMaster
author: Codeace

sections.description:
LinkMaster allows WordPress site administrators to easily define custom permalinks for individual posts and pages directly from the post edit screen. Whether you’re looking to create SEO-friendly URLs, simplify complex URLs, or organize content more efficiently, this plugin allows you to define custom permalinks for individual posts and pages-all directly from the post edit screen.

Unlike WordPress’s default permalink system, which limits you to predefined structures, this plugin provides flexibility to craft unique URLs without affecting the overall URL structure of your site.

Features

  • Custom Permalinks for Individual Posts & Pages
    Define unique, tailored permalinks for any post or page. This feature is ideal for creating SEO-friendly or user-friendly URLs.

  • Support for Special Characters in URLs
    Include special characters like ? in your permalinks for more flexible URL customization.

  • Seamless Integration with Popular Plugins
    Fully compatible with leading WordPress plugins, such as WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, WPML.

  • No Server Configuration Required
    The plugin requires no modifications to .htaccess or server settings, ensuring hassle-free setup and usage.

  • Parent Slug Removal
    Simplify long URLs by removing parent slugs, creating cleaner, shorter URL structures.

  • Multilingual Permalinks
    Compatible with WPML, allowing you to define language-specific URLs for multilingual sites.
sections.installation:
1. Direct Installation

    • Go to your WordPress dashboard.
    • Navigate to the Plugins menu and click on Add New.
    • In the search bar, type LinkMaster.
    • Click Install Now and then Activate the plugin.

  2. Manual Installation

    • Download the plugin’s ZIP file from the WordPress plugin repository.
    • Go to your WordPress dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin at the top of the screen.
    • Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
    • Once installed, click Activate Plugin to enable it on your site.

  3. Once installed and activated, navigate to any post or page edit screen to define custom permalinks directly.
sections.faq:
Do I need to modify .htaccess or server settings to use this plugin?

No, the plugin works out of the box and does not require any server-side configuration changes.

Can I use this plugin with WooCommerce or other popular plugins?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, WPML, and many other plugins.

Can I use this plugin for custom post types?

Currently, the plugin supports custom permalinks for posts and pages only. Support for custom post types is planned for future releases. Please check for updates if you require this feature.

What happens to existing permalinks if I deactivate the plugin?

Existing permalinks will revert to the default WordPress permalink structure. Custom permalinks set via the plugin will not function until the plugin is reactivated.
